Mockup notes

Not part of the store. The real home page has about a dozen blocks. List here which ones this store keeps, so the client says yes to a page that can be built. Hiding a block is Phase 3 work: only Testimonials and Video stories have a switch in src/config/features.ts; the others follow the home content and settings, so each hidden block is a small code change.

Shown in this mockup (stay)

  • Header with search and category links
  • Hero banner
  • Category display
  • One product row
  • One banner
  • Newsletter and footer

Home blocks left out: [NEED: decide per store]

  • Top deals
  • Best sellers and trending products
  • Featured product
  • Marquee band, feature icons, promo cards
  • Free-shipping band
  • Testimonials (only with real reviews)
  • Collection banner, video stories
